label: UniFi Dream Router
description: UniFi Dream Router (UDR) - 5x 1G RJ45 (2 PoE). WiFi 6; 19.37 W max.

poe.note: 40 W from the vendor datasheet, which prints it as its own row: "PoE budget 40W" beside "PoE interface (2) PoE (Pair B 4, 5+; 7, 8-)" and "Max. PoE wattage per port by PSE 15.4W" - two of the five GbE ports source 802.3af, so at most 30.8 W of the 40 W can be drawn and the budget never binds. The tech-spec table carries the same three figures (PoE Budget 40W / PoE 15.4W / Voltage Range PoE Mode 44-57V): https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/udr (read 2026-11-19). Before this, the row declared poe-pse and two poeOut ports with no budget at all, and the PoE allocator skips a PSE whose budget is 0 - so the Dream Router could not power a single phone.

notes:
Power: none of these copper ports accepts PoE. Vendor page https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/udr (HTTP 200, 685,837 B, read 2026-11-19, server-rendered tech-spec table) says "Power Method = Universal AC input, 100-240V AC, 1.1A Max, 50/60 Hz (the datasheet https://dl.ui.com/ds/udr_ds.pdf, 200, 771,202 B, says the same)"; a box fed from mains, a USB-C supply or a DC jack has no PoE-PD front end, so eth2 / eth3 / eth4 now declare poeIn: false. Without that declaration the engine's isPoePd() match on "unifi" gave each silent copper port a 12.95 W 802.3af draw - the defect PR #2118 and PR #2121 fixed across the UXG family (refs #130).

WiFi: the Dream Router carries an 802.11ax (WiFi 6) access point - "MIMO 2.4 GHz 4 x 4 / 5 GHz 4 x 4", "Throughput rate 2.4 GHz 600 Mbps / 5 GHz 2.4 Gbps", "WiFi standards 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax" in its own datasheet https://dl.ui.com/ds/udr_ds.pdf (HTTP 200, 771,202 B, 3 pages, text layer) and the same rows on https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/udr (HTTP 200, 685,837 B, read 2026-11-19). Hence radio0 = 2.4 GHz at 600 Mbps and radio1 = 5 GHz at 2.4 Gbps, both 4x4. `bands` is declared per radio because engine/media.js would otherwise give the 2.4 Gbps radio the whole 802.11ax band set, 6 GHz included, which this chassis does not have.
